headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 5, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a pair of victories, taking down the Washington Nationals 7-1 and 11-5. Braxton Ashcraft earned the win in the first game, while Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense in the second game. The Minnesota Twins also had a strong day, defeating the New York Yankees 11-4 behind Josh Bell's three home runs.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with the Milwaukee Brewers placing Brandon Woodruff on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Colorado Rockies have also been hit hard, placing Tomoyuki Sugano and Seth Halvorsen on the injured list with back spasms and right shoulder inflammation, respectively. Other teams affected by injuries include the Atlanta Braves, Texas Rangers, San Francisco Giants, and Pittsburgh Pirates.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Washington Nationals acquired Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros and Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles, while the Athletics traded Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 11-4**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a convincing 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees, with Josh Bell leading the charge at the plate. Bell hit 3 home runs, including a key 13th homer on a fly ball to right center field, scoring Kody Clemens.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rangers 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, with Jack Flaherty pitching 5.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Suffer Shutout Loss in Seattle**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays fell to the Seattle Mariners 11-0, marking a tough outing for the visiting team. Randy Arozarena led the Blue Jays' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Atlanta Braves, with multiple players contributing to the outcome. Juan Soto, Bo Bichette, and Tyrone Taylor were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, marking a strong performance for the team. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales, while the Nationals' Keibert Ruiz also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Brandon Woodruff Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation.

top_news.title: **Degges Heads to Cleveland in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians acquired RHP Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash on July 4, 2026.
